_comment: Per-state culture/religion mix, keyed on canon state key + naming anchor (never the Hilbert STATE number).
Default mix: the state's homelands (common/history/states add_homeland), the owner's primary cultures counting double.
'tags': a tag-wide default mix (shares sum to exactly 100). 'states': mode 'add' = minorities (shares sum < 100) are carved out of the default; mode 'replace' = the full mix (sum exactly 100).
religion only where it differs from the culture's default; pop_type only where deliberate ('slaves' only where the owner's slavery law allows it).
